kurz: Sweet dishes live on crystals, gels and foams: sugar that crystallises or [[karamellisierung|caramelises]], gelatine and [[pektin|pectin]] that set, eggs and cream that thicken or hold air.
bild_im_kopf: Like a workshop for structures: firm, creamy, airy or crunchy, and each needs its own tool.
was_passiert: Sugar can be glassy, grainy or caramelised, depending on how it is heated and cooled. Gelatine and pectin form networks that hold liquid. Chocolate only gets shine and snap with the right fat crystals.
warum_wichtig: Desserts are unforgiving, because a few degrees decide. If you understand the structures, you can rescue things instead of starting again.
faustregeln: A thermometer for sugar and chocolate.
Only dissolve gelatine, do not boil it for long: otherwise it sets more weakly.
